name: Azam Cheema
real_life_parallel: Real Azam Cheema — Lashkar-e-Taiba intelligence chief; 26/11 planner; never prosecuted in Pakistan

biography.background: Lashkar-e-Taiba intelligence chief and operational planner. Key figure in 26/11 Mumbai attacks planning. Despite being named in Indian and international investigations, never prosecuted in Pakistan.
biography.operational_role: Intelligence coordination; target selection; logistics planning
biography.impunity: Continues to operate in Pakistan despite 26/11 attribution; reflects state protection

risk_profile.description: Operates with impunity in Pakistan; risk is operational not legal

intelligence_signature.pattern: Coordinates with ISI S-Wing; planning precedes major attacks by months
